title: Office fills the stage: no black bars
goal: The Office room fills the whole stage on desktop (no dark bands beside or above it) while every station sprite, nameplate and the sign stay in view.

lanes.why: sizeStage letterboxes the room with Math.min; switch to a content-aware cover fit plus a blurred room backdrop for any remainder

next: verify fit checks and screenshots at 1920x945, 2560x1440, 1366x768
decisions: Cover the stage as far as the station content allows; any leftover band shows a blurred, dimmed copy of the room instead of the dark shell colour
risks: Ultra-wide screens cannot be fully covered without cropping stations; the blurred backdrop fills that band
